notes.title: v1.5.0 - New map, ability, specialty and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739023/e39c6affb1041f53cffce8b2644684527e208a51.png[/img]
Hello everyone! Version 1.5.0 is here and brings lots of new content to the game, here is a list of what I can remember:
[list]
[*]Shooting Range map, has targets you can shoot to test your damage
[*]Slow Zone ability, creates a spherical zone that makes time pass 4x slower
[*]Flesh Fuel specialty, removes ability cooldown and drains your health when using an ability instead
[*]Tips in the Character Customization in the Main Menu, these provide helpful tips about the game that you might no know.
[*]Advanced Movement setting in the Gameplay Settings, allows you to do flips when in midair
[*]Catapult in the Medieval map, allows you to launch yourself across the map
[*]Perfectly smooth movement on moving objects such as the boat on the Ocean map and flying cars in the Cloud City map.
[*]Reverb filter in the Mansion map
[/list]

The game will also be on a 50% discount as part of the Steam Autumn Sale for the next week. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content: Hello Everyone! This update does not change the gameplay in any way, only making the environment spookier.
